newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Prudential confident on UK outlook.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Prudential confident on UK outlook.

text.p: Prudential Corp expects its UK operations to continue to perform strongly in 1997 after finance director Jonathan Bloomer applauded healthy results from all the group's businesses over the past year.

"We had a very good result around the world in 1996 but particularly in the UK. We were growing sales off a low base from 1995 so the same percentage growth will be difficult but we're confident about 1997 in the UK," Bloomer told Reuters in an interview.
Bloomer was talking shortly after the group reported an eight percent increase in operating profits for the year to 873 million stg.

After four years which have seen Prudential UK's cost base reduced by 170 million stg the business was approaching a point of diminishing returns in searching for more savings though the group was loking to reduce unit costs further, said Bloomer.

He said that the Pru was still interested in establishing the high street distribution network a building society acquisition would provide but that it would not do anything unless it added value for shareholders.
"At the current levels of prices being talked about we don't think that's the case," he said.
